description: This file defines interfaces related to codecs in the Orleans serialization framework, particularly focusing on generalized and specialized codecs that can support multiple types.

classes.name: IGeneralizedCodec
classes.description: An interface for a codec supporting multiple types, extending IFieldCodec.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is supported by this codec.

classes.name: ISpecializableCodec
classes.description: An interface for codecs that can provide specialized codecs for specific types.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is supported.

methods.name: GetSpecializedCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a specialized IFieldCodec for a specific type.
